raw_response:
This small plot is only a small piece of my land here in Mtwara, and I grow it mixed with other crops like I always do. Cash is tight this season and fertilizer from the shop in town is expensive — most of us here do not put chemical fertilizer on these small plots, we save that money for the cashew or the bigger fields. I will put some manure from the goats and use the seed I kept from last harvest, like my neighbors do. The plot is small so my wife and I can manage it ourselves without hiring anyone.
